nozh.config.title: NOZH Configuration
nozh.config.enabled.tooltip: Enable/Disable NOZH FPS optimization. When enabled, the mod will automatically adjust graphics settings to maintain target FPS.
nozh.config.debug.tooltip: Enable detailed debug logging for troubleshooting. Warning: May impact performance slightly.
nozh.config.rollback.tooltip: Automatically revert changes if FPS worsens after an action. Recommended: ON for safety.
nozh.config.autotuning.tooltip: Allow NOZH to automatically make optimization decisions. If disabled, you must configure settings manually.
nozh.config.targetfps.tooltip: Desired FPS target. NOZH will try to maintain this framerate. Common values: 30 (stable), 60 (smooth), 90+ (high-end).
nozh.config.preset.low.tooltip: For older/slow PCs. Target 30 FPS with aggressive optimizations.
nozh.config.preset.mid.tooltip: Balanced settings for most PCs. Target 60 FPS with moderate optimizations.
nozh.config.preset.high.tooltip: For powerful PCs. Target 90 FPS with minimal interventions.
nozh.config.reset.tooltip: Reset all settings to default values. Requires confirmation.
nozh.config.reset_safemode.tooltip: Exit safe mode and resume normal operation. Use if the mod detected false positive crashes.
nozh.config.confirm.title: Confirm Reset
nozh.config.confirm.message: This will reset ALL configuration to defaults. Continue?
